summary: Intermittent power blips on Floor 3 causing devices to reset
description: Multiple employees on Floor 3 reported brief power blips between 09:30-11:00 local time over the past three weekdays. Symptoms: monitors briefly go black and reboot, USB hubs drop devices, some VoIP phones restart. No server-side outages observed. Blips correlate with use of kitchen appliances (coffee grinder, blender) but correlation is noisy. Impact is localized to non-critical desk equipment but is causing meeting interruptions and lost work. Steps attempted: swap power strips, moved a few affected desks to different PDUs, tested with dedicated UPS at one desk (no blips while on UPS). Building facilities team dispatched on 2026-02-15 and did a basic panel inspection; they reported no obvious loose breaker but noted voltage dips on monitoring probe during a simulated blender run. Next steps: schedule electrician to check floor-level breaker and isolation; provision temporary UPS units for high-priority desks and conference rooms; collect longer-term voltage logs for 24–48h.
comments: Priya Patel (2026-02-14): Noticed 3 reports this morning. Filing ticket so facilities/IT can investigate. Affected pods: C and D near kitchen.

Marcus Reed (2026-02-15): Visited floor, swapped power strips and tested desks; couldn't reproduce consistently. UPS at Desk C-12 prevented reboot during a blender test. Scheduling electrician for Thursday.

Facilities - Elena Gomez (2026-02-16): Installed temporary probe on panel; saw short dips (~0.8s) when grinder + microwave cycle. Recommend checking neutral/earth bonding and load balancing on phase B.
Marcus Reed (2026-02-18): Electrician scheduled 2026-02-19 08:00. Provisioning 3 small UPS units for conference rooms until issue confirmed.
Priya Patel (2026-02-18): Quick ask from managers: can we get conference room UPS priority until fixed? People rely on hybrid calls in those rooms.
workaround: Provide temporary UPS units to high-priority desks and conference rooms; advise staff to avoid simultaneous high-load kitchen appliance use during large calls.
